name: The Whisper Line
description: A stranger presses a note into your hand on a quiet station ring and is gone before you can ask a question. It is from Elian Marr - a friend who flew off the edge of the charts years ago and was never logged again. The note is a trail. Follow it out past the last relay and find out what Elian found.

intro.title: The Whisper Line
body: Years ago, Elian Marr took a deep-survey contract past the last lit beacon and did not come back. No wreck, no distress loop, no final position - just a name that stopped appearing in the traffic logs. The people who knew Elian stopped asking. You told yourself you had too.

You are {pilot}, tied up at a nowhere station ring with a courier hull and no run booked. That is where the note finds you - carried by a stranger who will not give a name, who keeps one eye on the airlock the whole time they talk, and who leaves the moment your hand closes on the paper.
The note is in Elian's hand. It is a set of directions, each line pointing to the next, out toward the dark. The last line is not a place. It is a warning.
